text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
InState(x, y) ::: x is in state y.
Visit(x, y) ::: x visited y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
Premises:
(MountainRange(picuris) ∧ (InState(picuris, newMexico) ∨ InState(picuris, texas))) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visit(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
LocatedIn(hardingPegmatiteMine, picuris) ∧ Mine(hardingPegmatiteMine) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ InState(x, texas) ∧ ∃y (LocatedIn(y, x) ∧ Mine(y) ∧ Donated(y))) ::: There are no mountain ranges in texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
Visit(juanDeOnate, picuris) ∧ MountainRange(picuris) ∧ InState(picuris, newMexico) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in New Mexico.
